name: UpdateNodeGroup

parameters.help_en: The custom executable shell script. The script must be Base64-encoded. The maximum size of the raw data is 16 KB
parameters.help_zh: 自定义可执行shell脚本，需要以 Base64 方式编码，原始数据最多为 16 KB
parameters.name: user_data

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether file storage mounting is supported
parameters.help_zh: 是否支持文件存储挂载
parameters.name: file_system_mount_enabled

parameters.help_en:
The RAM role name of the node. You can call the RAM API ListRoles to query the node RAM roles that you have created. The trusted entity of the role must be set to Lingjun AI Computing Service.
<warning>If you set this parameter to an empty string (""), the RAM role of the node group is cleared.</warning>
parameters.help_zh:
节点 RAM 角色名称。您可以使用 RAM API ListRoles 查询您已创建的节点 RAM 角色。设置的角色的信任主体必须为“智能计算灵骏”。
<warning>提交值为空字符串""表示清空节点组的 RAM 角色。</warning>
parameters.name: ram_role_name

parameters.help_en: The default image ID of the node group. If this parameter is not specified, the image remains unchanged
parameters.help_zh: 节点组的默认镜像id，如果不设置，那么就不会改变
parameters.name: image_id

parameters.help_en: The logon password of the machines in the node group
parameters.help_zh: 节点组内机器的登录密码
parameters.name: login_password
